response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY (AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL), avg_aCL_IgM DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies only if they have at least one examination and none of their examinations has ANA Pattern 'S'.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude examinations with ANA Pattern 'S', then average the remaining examinations for each patient.
alternatives.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S' OR e.`ANA Pattern` IS NULL GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL), avg_aCL_IgM DESC LIMIT 10;
